root_prerequisites: Live command usage exposes startup callback and temporary-directory interfaces
Live temporary directory contains executable Magisk command
Host root layout has valid executable ELF/program segments and required overlay/command markers
Original firmware init retained and recognized
Local original CPIO records preserved byte-for-byte
runtime_probe_side_effects: Read-only usage/path queries; no boot-stage callback dispatched as a probe
retained_guards: Ambiguous payload layouts and conflicting early init hooks
limitations: ELF/CLI indicators establish prerequisites, not proof of all future boot-stage semantics
Each first-binding private image still requires actual boot qualification and rollback preparation
KernelSU/APatch ordinary module admission is root-neutral; actual mounting and ABI remain required
Unknown early root hooks and recovery/vendor_boot layouts require separate adaptation
privacy: Root payload digests recorded only in private preparation metadata; firmware, root APKs, personal images and logs excluded from source/package
evidence_scope: Existing Magisk target physically accepted; other stable/prerelease and local variants are offline inputs only
